moments.text: Low-contrast grey infrared view with a crosshair. A small faint white dot appears upper right, swings down past the crosshair and hovers close to it.
A flash, then the view zooms in to flat grainy grey with no dot visible; at 0:27 it zooms back out.
In the wider view the dot sinks below the crosshair, then drifts slowly back up onto it.
A second faint dot appears upper left and drifts right across the top of the frame, while the first slides down toward the bottom edge.
The second dot slips behind the black box at top centre; the first, very faint, lingers near the bottom edge until about 1:32.
The second dot reappears under the top box and drops down to just right of the crosshair.
Black frame, then the sensor cycles its zoom: a grainy close-up, another black frame, then a wide view with faint ripple texture. No dot visible.
A faint white dot hovers near the crosshair, first below and right of it, later above and right, growing harder to see.
The sensor cycles its zoom over plain grey; from about 3:25 the picture shades bright at top to dark below. No dot visible.

notes: Very low contrast; dots are 2-3 px and faint. No black bars; redaction boxes over HUD.
